08/07/2009: Station Maintenance:                                        [1100] 
 
            - Faulty Solar Radiation Sensor was replaced. 
 
 
07/31/2009: Station Maintenance:                                        [1000] 
 
            - Recent data outage was due to a lightning strike.  The 
              logger was replaced along with a new wind vane/anemometer. 
 
            - However, it appears that the solar radiation sensor is  
              not reporting. 
 
 
07/29/2009: Data Outage: 
 
            - The Logger connected to the Petersburg MAWN station 
              appears to have failed at the following time: 
 
                 07/23/2009 (d=204) 20:30 
 
              Repairs are being scheduled for possibly later this 
              week.

              - weed removal and application of Round-Up above soil temps 
 
            - Work was done approx: 11:20 - 11:35 (Day=245) 
 
 
 
============================================================================== 
08/15/2003: Precipitation Guage Corrected: 
 
            - Tipping-bucket rain gauge was found clogged with  
              debris and was cleaned out on Thu, Aug 14, 2003. 
     
            - Precipitation values during the time of obstruction 
              are inaccurate due to the decreased flow through the 
              funnel.  Precipitation values were marked as "missing" 
              for the following days: 
 
                 Aug 01, 2003 (Day 213)  thru  Aug 14, 2003 (Day 226) 
 
            - Total amount of measured precipitation removed from the 
              database during the time listed above: 
 
                 2.79 inches 
 
 
 
============================================================================== 
07/31/2002: Telecommunication Repair: 
 
            - Telephone service was lost on July 22 due to  
              thunderstorms in the area.  Phone company made  
              repairs and service was re-established. 
 
            - No data was lost.  Datalogger continued to  
              collect data while phone service was down. 
 
 
04/08/2002: Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
            - Daylight Savings Time Started on Day=97, Time=200. 
 
            - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (forward)  
              from Day=97, Time=200 through Day=97, Time=415. 
 
 
10/31/2001: Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
 
            - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=301, Time=200. 
 
            - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
              from Day=301, Time=200 through Day=301, Time=610 
 
 
10/30/2000: Daylight Savings Time Adjustment. 
                 
            - Daylight Savings Time Ended on Day=303, Time=200. 
 
            - Time of Obs were modified by one hour (subtracted) 
              from Day=303, Time=200 through Day=304, Time=1445. 
              Only Observation Times were modified, not times of 
              Maxs and Mins.  Users will need to take that into 
              consideration when using this data. 
 
 
05/09/2000: Installed Leaf Wetness A - installed on wooden block 
            attached to NE Leg (approx. 1 meter high) - facing 
            north.  Install Time: Approx: 10:30am 
 
            Added 2 new Desi-Packs to Enclosure as there were no 
            existing packs in the enclosure. 
 
            Soil Temps are buried under sod - RoundUp has not 
            yet been applied. 
 
 
02/07/2000: Fixed old data to reflect recent change in "mawn1b" 
            program - padded missing values to 5-minute data. 
 
 
02/05/2000: Updated "mawn1b" to include Wind Speed, Air Temp, 
            and Relative Humidity in 5-minute data. 
 
 
11/18/1999: Phone Line To Station Activated.   
 
            - Petersburg station added to MAWN database. 
 
 
11/11/1999: Station Installed: 
  
            - Leaf Wetness Sensors Disconnected For The Winter. 
 
            - Soil Probe A:    2-inch under sod, east of south leg. 
 
            - Soil Probe B:    4-inch under sod, east of south leg, south of 
                               Soil Probe A. 
 
            - Soil Moisture A: On sod, south and east of south leg, west 
                               of Soil Moisture B. 
 
            - Soil Moisture B: On sod, south and east of south leg, east  
                               of Soil Moisture A. 
 
            - Data Logging Activated (mawn1b) 
 
            - Data Logger Start Time:  12:40pm, Day=315
